messages:
maria_marketing: Heads-up — we just got an alert from the leadflow dashboard: ~18 webinar leads this morning went into HubSpot but stayed in the enrichment queue for >10m and never hit SDR rotation :eyes:
ajay_revops: ugh, that will blow our lead SLA for EMEA. any pattern on source or enrichment step?
sam_engops: looking — initial pump shows the webhook delivered to enrichment service, but enrichment returned `status: pending` because of a 429 from the enrichment API. Then the hubspot workflow didn't fall back to the default owner.
maria_marketing: exact symptoms: attendees from last night's APAC webinar, HubSpot property `lead_enrichment_state` stuck on `in_progress`. Sales complained reps didn't get alerts.
jamie_sdr: i got zero notifications. normally even if enrichment is slow, round-robin still assigns. did the RR job error out?
sam_engops: RR job ran but our claim handler skipped leads flagged `enrichment_required=true`. someone changed the filter in the last ruleset.
ajay_revops: that filter was intended to avoid assigning unscored leads, but it shouldn't prevent a fallback. we need two actions: 1) short-term fix so fallback owner kicks in after X seconds 2) long-term: make enrichment non-blocking for assignment.
maria_marketing: agree. what X do people want? 5s? 30s? :thinking_face:
jamie_sdr: 15s seems safe. more than that delays handoff.
ajay_revops: propose 10s. we can monitor error noise and iterate.
sam_engops: OK — I can patch the RR claim lambda to treat `enrichment_required` as advisory and use a `fallback_owner` after 10s if enrichment hasn't completed. quick code patch below I'll roll out to the canary pool now:
```
// claim lambda patch (snippet)
if (lead.enrichment_required && now - lead.enrichment_start < 10000) {
  // still waiting, try normal RR claim
  tryClaimRoundRobin(lead)
} else {
  assignFallbackOwner(lead)
}
```
ajay_revops: nice. also add an event to analytics `lead_assigned_before_enrichment` so we can track quality regressions.
maria_marketing: please add an alert when fallback assignments >5% in a 1h window — we don't want silent degradations.
sam_engops: will do. patching canary now, will post deploy logs.
leadflow_bot: Deploy started: claim-lambda v2.4.7-canary -> 3 nodes (eng-canary). CI checks passed.
sam_engops: canary deployed. sanity check: I kicked 6 test leads via the staging webhook (payload below) and 5/6 were assigned to fallback owner after 10s — exactly what we expected.
```
POST /webhook/leads
{
  "source": "webinar",
  "region": "emea",
  "lead_enrichment_state": "in_progress",
  "lead_enrichment_start": 3850003000
}
```
jamie_sdr: thanks — any customer-facing risk? will reps see duplicate notifications later when enrichment completes and score updates?
sam_engops: we emit `assignment_reason: fallback_due_to_enrichment_timeout`. when enrichment completes and score arrives, we do not reassign owners unless a higher priority rule triggers — so no dup pings.
ajay_revops: good. next: HubSpot workflow change — add a `Set owner if empty` step immediately after intake so HubSpot has a fallback too if our service is busy. can marketing ops handle that?
maria_marketing: I can submit the change in HubSpot now and include a note in the workflow history. I'll set it to assign `marketing_ops_pool` and mark `auto_assigned=true` so we can filter.
\amajay_revops: (typo) — meant to say @maria_marketing: please include a comment and link to this thread.
maria_marketing: done. HubSpot workflow updated and published. link: https://redwood.hubspot.com/workflows/5421 (internal) :white_check_mark:
leadflow_bot: Alert: SLA breach rate for inbound handoffs spiked to 4.8% between 03:00-04:00 UTC — now stable after canary.
ajay_revops: that's within our immediate threshold but trending. next steps: 1) rollout claim-lambda patch to prod (sam) 2) add analytics event & dashboard (ajay) 3) HubSpot owner rule (maria) 4) run a 24h sampling to measure lead_quality delta (maria + jamie).
sam_engops: planning prod rollout in 10m. will roll in 3 waves, monitor fallback >5% and lead conversion change.
jamie_sdr: i'll monitor Slack alerts and report any rep feedback.
maria_marketing: thanks team. can we do a retro tomorrow to tweak the `enrichment_required` flag semantics? we should document: enrichment = advisory not blocker.
ajay_revops: agreed — scheduling 9am PT retro. calendar invite incoming. :calendar:
sam_engops: PROD rollout done. no immediate regressions. closing thread once analytics dashboard shows stable conversion after 24h.
maria_marketing: appreciated. 
jamie_sdr: :thumbsup:
